sprint: Planned Example Completion Gap Analysis and Full-Coverage Generation Design

completion_stages.name: discovered_api_item
completion_stages.description: A public type found in the LowCode namespace via DllReflector. Exists in the API catalog.

completion_stages.name: candidate_scenario
completion_stages.description: A discovered type classified as a runnable entrypoint (workflow_root or operation_facade). Has a role classification.

completion_stages.name: planned_example
completion_stages.description: A candidate scenario that the scenario planner has built into a Scenario object with target_methods, output_plan, etc. This is the first point where an 'example' exists as a concept.

completion_stages.name: selected_example
completion_stages.description: A planned example that passes the allowlist filter AND all readiness checks (fixture available, options strategy known). Enters the generation queue.

completion_stages.name: generated_example
completion_stages.description: LLM has produced a Program.cs, .csproj, README.md, manifest, and expected-output.json for this scenario.

completion_stages.name: repaired_example
completion_stages.description: If the initial generation failed build or runtime validation, the build-repair or runtime-repair loop produced a corrected version. (Optional stage — many pass without repair.)

completion_stages.name: reviewer_checked_example
completion_stages.description: The example-reviewer has evaluated the example and returned pass/fail. Currently pass/fail only — no per-example structured feedback.

completion_stages.name: validated_example
completion_stages.description: The example has passed: restore, build, runtime, output validation, and reviewer. All gates green.

completion_stages.name: package_candidate
completion_stages.description: The validated example has been assembled into a PR dry-run package with root config files (Directory.Packages.props, etc.).

completion_stages.name: pr_published_example
completion_stages.description: A live PR has been created on the target family repo containing this example. PR is OPEN.

completion_stages.name: merged_example
completion_stages.description: The PR has been merged to main. The example exists on the main branch of the target repo and passes clean-checkout validation.

completion_stages.name: deferred_or_backlogged
completion_stages.description: The example was intentionally excluded from the current run with a documented reason and a path back to completion.

definitions.when_is_an_item_planned: An item becomes 'planned' at Stage 3, when the scenario planner creates a Scenario object for it. Before that, it is merely a 'discovered type' (Stage 1) or 'candidate' (Stage 2). The current system conflates Stages 1-3 by creating one scenario per discovered type, then immediately blocking non-runnable types.
definitions.when_can_it_be_excluded: Exclusion is allowed at ANY stage, but must always have: (a) an explicit blocked_reason or excluded_reason, (b) a classification (scope limit, system gap, API limitation), (c) a path to future completion (taskcard or backlog entry) unless the exclusion is permanent (e.g., abstract_base class).
definitions.acceptable_exclusion: An exclusion is acceptable when the type is genuinely non-runnable (abstract class, options bag, enum, result type, provider callback) OR when it is temporarily out of scope for a controlled pilot with a documented backlog entry.
definitions.system_gap_exclusion: An exclusion is a SYSTEM GAP when a runnable workflow_root/operation_facade type is excluded because the system lacks capability to generate, validate, or publish it — not because it was intentionally deferred.
definitions.pilot_scope_vs_incomplete_coverage: A controlled pilot intentionally restricts scope to de-risk. Incomplete coverage means the system CANNOT complete examples even without scope restrictions. The current state is BOTH: pilots restrict scope, AND system gaps would block some examples even without the restriction.
definitions.full_completion_metric: true_completion_rate = merged_count / candidate_scenario_count (Stage 11 / Stage 2). For a family to be 'fully complete', every candidate scenario should be merged or have a permanent waiver.
